sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: A number decreased by 9 equals 34. Find the number.
Three times a number, minus 7, equals 32. Find the number.
The sum of two numbers is 58. One number is 12 more than the other. Find both numbers.
questions.answer: Let the smaller be $x$: $x+(x+12)=58\Rightarrow2x=46\Rightarrow x=23$. The numbers are $23$ and $35$.
questions.explanation: Let the smaller be $x$: $x+(x+12)=58\Rightarrow2x=46\Rightarrow x=23$. The numbers are $23$ and $35$.

questions.q: A two-digit number has digit sum 11. Reversing its digits gives a number 45 more than the original. Find the original number.
questions.answer: Let the digits be $t$ (tens) and $u$ (units): $t+u=11$ and $(10u+t)-(10t+u)=45\Rightarrow u-t=5$. Solving together: $u=8$, $t=3$. The original number is $38$.
questions.explanation: Let the digits be $t$ (tens) and $u$ (units): $t+u=11$ and $(10u+t)-(10t+u)=45\Rightarrow u-t=5$. Solving together: $u=8$, $t=3$. The original number is $38$.

questions.q: A father is 4 times as old as his daughter. In 5 years, he will be 3 times as old as she will be. Find their current ages.
questions.answer: Let the daughter be $x$, father $4x$: $4x+5=3(x+5)\Rightarrow4x+5=3x+15\Rightarrow x=10$. Daughter is $10$, father is $40$.
questions.explanation: Let the daughter be $x$, father $4x$: $4x+5=3(x+5)\Rightarrow4x+5=3x+15\Rightarrow x=10$. Daughter is $10$, father is $40$.

questions.q: Sara is twice as old as her brother. In 6 years, the sum of their ages will be 42. Find their current ages.
questions.answer: Let the brother be $x$, Sara $2x$: $(x+6)+(2x+6)=42\Rightarrow3x=24\Rightarrow x=10$. Brother is $10$, Sara is $20$.
questions.explanation: Let the brother be $x$, Sara $2x$: $(x+6)+(2x+6)=42\Rightarrow3x=24\Rightarrow x=10$. Brother is $10$, Sara is $20$.

questions.q: Ahmed is 5 years older than Salem. Seven years ago, Ahmed was twice as old as Salem. Find their current ages.
questions.answer: Let Salem be $x$, Ahmed $x+5$: $(x+5-7)=2(x-7)\Rightarrow x-2=2x-14\Rightarrow x=12$. Salem is $12$, Ahmed is $17$.
questions.explanation: Let Salem be $x$, Ahmed $x+5$: $(x+5-7)=2(x-7)\Rightarrow x-2=2x-14\Rightarrow x=12$. Salem is $12$, Ahmed is $17$.

sections.heading: Part II — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Intermediate Multi-Step Application (8–14)

questions.q: The sum of a mother's and daughter's ages is 50. The mother is 20 years older than the daughter. Find both ages.
questions.answer: Let the daughter be $d$: $d+(d+20)=50\Rightarrow2d=30\Rightarrow d=15$. Daughter is $15$, mother is $35$.
questions.explanation: Let the daughter be $d$: $d+(d+20)=50\Rightarrow2d=30\Rightarrow d=15$. Daughter is $15$, mother is $35$.

sections.heading: Part III — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Challenging & Cross-Lesson Synthesis (15–20)

questions.q: 6 workers can complete a job in 8 days. How many days would 4 workers take, at the same rate?
questions.answer: Total work $=6\times8=48$ worker-days. With $4$ workers: $48\div4=12$ days.
questions.explanation: Total work $=6\times8=48$ worker-days. With $4$ workers: $48\div4=12$ days.

questions.q: A pipe fills a tank in 12 hours, but a leak can empty a full tank in 24 hours. If both act at once, how long to fill the tank?
A jeweler mixes gold worth 200 riyals/gram with silver worth 50 riyals/gram to make 10 grams of a mixture worth 110 riyals/gram. How many grams of gold are used?
questions.answer: Let $g$ be grams of gold: $200g+50(10-g)=110\times10\Rightarrow150g=600\Rightarrow g=4$ grams.
questions.explanation: Let $g$ be grams of gold: $200g+50(10-g)=110\times10\Rightarrow150g=600\Rightarrow g=4$ grams.

questions.q: A shopkeeper has 15 riyals in 1-riyal and 2-riyal coins, 10 coins in total. How many of each coin does she have?
questions.answer: Let $x$ be 1-riyal coins, $y$ be 2-riyal coins: $x+y=10$, $x+2y=15$. Subtracting: $y=5$, $x=5$.
questions.explanation: Let $x$ be 1-riyal coins, $y$ be 2-riyal coins: $x+y=10$, $x+2y=15$. Subtracting: $y=5$, $x=5$.

questions.q: A solution is $40\%$ acid. How many liters of pure water must be added to 20 liters of this solution to dilute it to $25\%$ acid?
questions.answer: Acid amount stays $0.4\times20=8$ liters. $\frac{8}{20+w}=0.25\Rightarrow20+w=32\Rightarrow w=12$ liters.
questions.explanation: Acid amount stays $0.4\times20=8$ liters. $\frac{8}{20+w}=0.25\Rightarrow20+w=32\Rightarrow w=12$ liters.

questions.q: Event tickets cost 30 riyals for adults and 18 riyals for children. 150 tickets were sold for 3,780 riyals in total. How many adult tickets were sold?
questions.answer: Let $a$ be adults, so $150-a$ children: $30a+18(150-a)=3{,}780\Rightarrow12a=1{,}080\Rightarrow a=90$ adult tickets.
questions.explanation: Let $a$ be adults, so $150-a$ children: $30a+18(150-a)=3{,}780\Rightarrow12a=1{,}080\Rightarrow a=90$ adult tickets.

Yousef is 5 times as old as his younger sibling. In 6 years, the sum of their ages will be 60. Find their current ages.
questions.answer: Let the sibling be $x$, Yousef $5x$: $(x+6)+(5x+6)=60\Rightarrow6x+12=60\Rightarrow6x=48\Rightarrow x=8$. Sibling is $8$, Yousef is $40$.
questions.explanation: Let the sibling be $x$, Yousef $5x$: $(x+6)+(5x+6)=60\Rightarrow6x+12=60\Rightarrow6x=48\Rightarrow x=8$. Sibling is $8$, Yousef is $40$.

questions.q: Worker A can complete a job in 12 hours; Worker B can complete the same job in 4 hours. Working together, how long will it take them?

After spending half her money on a book, then 13 riyals on lunch, Huda has 18 riyals left. How much did she start with?
questions.answer: Let the start be $x$: $\frac{x}{2}-13=18\Rightarrow\frac{x}{2}=31\Rightarrow x=62$ riyals.
questions.explanation: Let the start be $x$: $\frac{x}{2}-13=18\Rightarrow\frac{x}{2}=31\Rightarrow x=62$ riyals.
